tagline: AI SRE and incident agents, infrastructure agents, CI/CD agents and the tools that let agents run operations.
scope: It is about AI agents doing operations work, not a general DevOps product with no agent story.
heroAlt: Animated isometric scene: code sheets ride a belt through build, test and deploy gates, becoming checked containers that enter a server rack, until its alert beacon flashes red and an agent arm swings over to turn it green.
